Publisher description and license statement captured 2026-09-24 UTC.
Source: https://valsekamerplant.itch.io/psx-style-going-medieval

This asset pack includes a whole bunch of modular building pieces that you can snap together like LEGO to make an infinite variety of medieval buildings for your PSX style game.
A little list of everything that is in the pack (for now):
33 Roof pieces
8 door variations
4 window variations
8 types of stairs
7 plants
4 vine variations
3 chimneys
5 overhangs
34 building blocks
6 market stalls
10 hay stacks
14 barrel varriations
bunch of barrel lids
4 jute sacks
4 terracotta vases
21 variations of baskets with food
3 types of bread
suasages and link variant
4 meat
https://sketchfab.com/models/d957e04d258b4d4da7da26e40b010e3a/embed?autostart=1&camera=0&preload=1&transparent=1
PSX style medieval building blocks
by
valse kamerplant
on
Sketchfab
I know this is a bit different from my other pack, but there is a little supporter pack here. Nothing gamechanging and you can still make amazing stuff without it. It just offers a bit more variation.
10 round variations of the building blocks
4 flared building block variations
round roofs
barn-style roofs
high roofs
8 more styles
and some railings
This pack is CC0 and all textures were obtained by using CC0 textures or my own photos. Special thanks to KenneyNL for his PSX texture pack
I would love to hear from you if this made it into a project you made! I would also appreciate it if you rated my packs, so more people can find them, and I know what I can improve in the future.
